scope: Behavior-level scheduling operations: task state transitions for action start/completion/damage completion markers, IncludeTaskListTemplate expansion, fixed and conditional loops, action delay set/add/reset, and inserted-action configuration records. Global AV recomputation and candidate arbitration are a later global scheduler packet.

evidence.support: E4 TaskState enum with Ready 0x7777 / Executing 0x8888 / Success 0x9999 / Fail 0xAAAA and generated task-executor transition evidence.
E4 ordinary turn prepare / AV advance anchor; not extended here.
marker, template, loop, delay and inserted-action argument shapes used to select each model.

selected_model.task_state: TaskState uses the recovered raw values READY=0x7777, EXECUTING=0x8888, SUCCESS=0x9999, FAIL=0xAAAA.
selected_model.action_start_marker: SkillExecutionStart transitions the owning task to EXECUTING and opens the action phase boundary.
selected_model.action_completion_marker: SkillPerformFinish transitions the owning task to SUCCESS at the action completion boundary; following behavior is a nested event under KERNEL-EVENT-001 ordering.
selected_model.damage_completion_marker: DamagePerformFinish is an ordered damage-completion boundary, not presentation; HP/absorption commits are owned by PRIM-DAMAGE-001 and PRIM-SURVIVAL-001.
selected_model.template_invocation: IncludeTaskListTemplate resolves its Name against the record's canonical template_definitions and expands the template operations in place in source order. Invocation arguments are preserved losslessly on each expanded node; formula/dynamic-value substitution is deferred to the formula resolver.
selected_model.fixed_loop: LoopExecuteTaskListWithInterval executes its TaskList children exactly MaxLoopCount times in order; only non-dynamic non-negative integer MaxLoopCount is accepted.
selected_model.conditional_loop: ConditionLoopExecuteTaskListWithInterval evaluates its Predicate before every iteration and stops on the first false; a selected recursion guard of 1000 iterations raises instead of looping forever.
selected_model.delay_set: SetActionDelay.Value sets the normalized action delay (clamped at zero).
selected_model.delay_add: ModifyActionDelay.AddNormalizedValue adds to the current normalized delay and clamps at zero.
selected_model.delay_reset: ResetActionDelay sets zero and preserves SkipTargetTurn.
selected_model.inserted_action: TurnInsertAbility/TurnInsertAction produce immutable InsertedActionSpec records with ability/target/priority/tags preserved; queue arbitration, AV cost and legal-action recomputation remain separate packets.

unsupported_cases: global AV recomputation and speed mutation
interrupt semantics and action queue arbitration
Ultimate insertion and follow-up legality beyond InsertedActionSpec
acceptance_fixture: tests/game_data/test_scheduler_semantics_reference.py proves marker task states, delay set/add/reset/clamp, fixed loop expansion, conditional loop guard, template expansion with invocation arguments, and inserted-action parsing.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement task states and boundaries with the recovered raw values; never guess MaxLoopCount, never loop forever, and never treat markers as presentation no-ops. Unsupported scheduler operations reject the containing behavior.
